factArr = [1] * MAX
invFactArr = [1] * MAX

        factArr[i] = (factArr[i - 1] * i) % MOD

def nCr(n, r):
    return (factArr[n] * invFactArr[r] % MOD) * invFactArr[n - r] % MOD

def power(base, exp):

    b = base % MOD
    e = exp
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            result = (result * b) % MOD
        b = (b * b) % MOD
